modern: Adapt yourself to the things among which your lot has been cast; and the men among whom you have received your portion, love them, but do it sincerely.
original: Adapt thyself to the things with which thy lot has been cast: and the men among whom thou hast received thy portion, love them, but do it truly [sincerely].
notification: Adapt yourself to the things among which your lot has been cast; and the men among whom you have received your portion, love them, but do it sincerely.
notification_original: Adapt thyself to the things with which thy lot has been cast: and the men among whom thou hast received thy portion, love them, but do it truly [sincerely].

explained.summary: Fit yourself to the circumstances you’ve been given, and love the people you’ve ended up living among, and mean it. Marcus isn’t asking for tolerance or politeness, but for real affection towards the people fate has placed around you.
explained.today: You didn’t pick your colleagues, your in-laws or the neighbours on your street. Making the best of the job you’re in, and actually caring about those people rather than wishing for different ones, is what Marcus means.
